correctness.rationale: The factor classification is exhaustive (0 or 2 ones). Each two-one factor is uniquely indexed by exposed zeros and parity plus the diagonal-band condition. Counting forbidden corners via the exact H identity proves the closed form for all nonnegative gaps. A planar strip area identity has a unique normalized maximizer and the parity lattice discrepancy is uniformly O(n), proving the sharp 1/16 asymptotic and rigidity. Direct independent factor enumeration matches the closed form on 1331 triples; computation is corroboration rather than the infinite proof.
